description: FlightQueue answers practical airport questions with live data for 8,000+ airports. Users can check the security wait at an airport right now, get a forecast for a departure later this week, work out when to leave for a specific flight, see current FAA ground stops and delay programs, check EU Entry/Exit System border queues across Schengen, look up lounges and terminals, read aviation weather, and compare airlines on mishandled baggage. Users can also report the wait they actually experienced, which feeds the shared prediction model, and set an alert for when a wait crosses a threshold.

defaultPrompt: How long is the security line at JFK right now?
Are there FAA ground stops at Newark today?
How long is passport control at Paris CDG?
